login.tagline: Build, run and trace agents on your own runtime.
login.introWeb: Studio talks to AgentFlow’s admin API with its bearer token. Nothing is stored on a server.
login.introDesktop: Studio talks to AgentFlow's admin API with its bearer token. No browser, no CORS.
login.tokenHint: ADMIN_TOKEN, a named operator token (runtime.admin.operators), or the per-boot token AgentFlow prints at startup.
login.proxyUnavailable: Not available on this origin, so the browser calls the runtime directly: add "{origin}" to runtime.admin.cors_origins.
login.proxyRequired: Required for sockets and pipes: a browser cannot open them itself.
login.proxyOn: No CORS setup needed: the browser talks to this origin, which forwards to the runtime.
login.proxyOff: Direct from the browser: the runtime must list "{origin}" in runtime.admin.cors_origins.
login.rememberBrowser: Remember the token in this browser
login.rememberBrowserOn: Stored in plain text in this browser profile’s localStorage. Lock forgets it.
login.rememberBrowserOff: Kept for this tab only; closing the tab forgets it.
login.rememberKeychain: Remember the token in the OS keychain
login.rememberKeychainOn: Stored in your operating system’s credential manager (Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Secret Service), not in plain text localStorage. Lock forgets it.
login.rememberDesktop: Remember the token on this computer
login.rememberDesktopNote: Stored in plain text, owner-only, in {path}. Lock forgets it.
login.tokenRejected: The runtime rejected this token. Check ADMIN_TOKEN, or copy the token AgentFlow printed at boot (it changes every start unless ADMIN_TOKEN is set).
login.nothingAnswered: Nothing answered here. Is AgentFlow running, and is this its address (gateway.listen, or runtime.admin.socket with tcp: false)?
login.localOnly: This runtime answers its admin API only on its own machine: its token is minted per boot. Set ADMIN_TOKEN (or runtime.admin.operators) on the runtime to connect from here.
login.studioOff:
{message}

The Studio API is off on this runtime: set runtime.studio.enabled: true and restart AgentFlow.
login.noAnswer: No answer within 20 seconds. Check the address and that nothing blocks the port.
